episode_summary: This episode dives into the ongoing conflict between Compass, Zillow, and MLS over listing data control, highlighting the lack of agent advocacy in the industry. Ben Lalez shares innovative solutions using AI, including a cancellation insurance product and automated content creation, providing valuable insights for agents looking to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving market.
